Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

bus — a large road vehicle for many people. Example: I go to work by bus.
train — a vehicle that runs on rails. Example: The train leaves at nine.
car — a road vehicle for a small group. Example: My father drives a car.
bicycle — a vehicle with two wheels you pedal. Example: I ride a bicycle to work.
taxi — a car you pay to travel in. Example: A taxi is expensive.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I go by bus.
• She goes by train.
• I go on foot.
• How do you travel to work?
• It is cheap and fast.

Grammar focus: Prepositions of transport (by bus, on foot).
Use by + transport: by bus, by train, by car, by taxi. But say on foot. Ask How do you travel to work?
